query: INSERT INTO org_recovery_grants (org_id, key_version, account_id, sealed_key, grant_data, grant_signature, granted_by, created_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8) ON CONFLICT (org_id, key_version, account_id) DO UPDATE SET sealed_key = excluded.sealed_key, grant_data = excluded.grant_data, grant_signature = excluded.grant_signature, granted_by = excluded.granted_by, created_at = excluded.created_at
